mechanism: Both drugs cause potassium retention and sodium depletion through different mechanisms, creating additive hyperkalemia risk and potential hyponatremia, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium and sodium closely; adjust doses based on electrolytes and renal function; consider alternative diuretic or reduce eplerenone dose; contraindicated if baseline potassium >5.0 mEq/L or creatinine clearance <30 mL/min.
